Method of Attack: Monitoring mobile devices without user knowledge
Collecting sensitive user information like location and online activity
Requiring jailbroken devices to install, exposing to security vulnerabilities
Allowing removal of app icons to hide presence
Failure to keep collected data confidential and safe
Cloud storage breaches via unencrypted and obfuscated account credentials
Harvesting and exfiltrating login usernames, encrypted passwords, text messages, GPS locations, contacts, and photos
Impacted Systems: Mobile devices of children and employees
Attack Vector: Cloud storage breaches exploiting unencrypted and obfuscated credentials
Indicators of Compromise: Data breach incidents in February 2017 and February 2018
Exfiltrated data including login usernames, encrypted passwords, text messages, GPS locations, contacts, and photos
